scientific_integrity: The 2026 global harmonic mean-width and perimeter contraction theorem and its equality rigidity are prior results. The claimed contribution is the full local Fourier Hessian, sharp spectral gap, and exact first-/second-harmonic mode switch. Numerical finite checks supplement an explicit proof; earlier unindexed coverage cannot be ruled out.
scientific_limitations: Second variation only for fixed smooth boundary angle perturbations of planar harmonic Poisson extensions, at each fixed radius 0<r<1; the small-parameter remainder depends on the perturbation and radius. No global nonlinear stability statement, arbitrary boundary-trace theorem, or independent mathematical validation is claimed.
title: A sharp Fourier-mode stability transition for harmonic perimeter contraction
